I am a microbiologist with academic background in BSc (2019) and MSc (2020) in Microbiology from Jahangirnagar University and professional experience in the pharmaceutical industry. I currently work as an Executive in Quality Control – Microbiology at Aristopharma Ltd.
Alongside my professional work, I am developing my expertise in bioinformatics and computational biology, with a particular interest in high-throughput sequencing data analysis and the molecular mechanisms underlying disease.

title: Md Osman Gani Bhuiyan
text:
Hello, I am Md Osman Gani Bhuiyan.
I am a microbiologist with a strong interest in bioinformatics, computational biology, genomics, and cancer research. I am passionate about integrating biological and computational approaches to explore complex biological questions and contribute to biomedical research. I aspire to pursue a PhD and develop interdisciplinary expertise at the intersection of microbiology, genomics, and computational science.
Currently, I am working as Research Assistant at CHIRAL. I am also an Executive in Quality Control – Microbiology at Aristopharma Ltd.
